llm.summary: This Markdown-only skill provides disclosed workplace communication advice using personality heuristics and does not request code execution, credentials, network access, persistence, or privileged actions.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not ask for local files, credentials, accounts, APIs, broad indexing, network access, or mutation authority. The requested information is user-supplied conversational context proportionate to the advisory purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown skill and reference files only; scanner inventory and file inspection showed no executable scripts, dependency installation steps, or remote payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to conversational intake, conditional reference reading, language matching, type estimation, and advice formatting. I found no prompt override, hidden agent-control instruction, exfiltration, or unsafe automatic action.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No artifact instruction creates persistence, background workers, scheduled tasks, memory writes, privilege escalation, or tool wrapping.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and instructions are coherent: it gathers minimal user-provided type, relationship, and scenario context to produce workplace communication guidance. Its MBTI/Jungian framing is explicitly described as a heuristic, not a scientific test.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using personality-type heuristics for workplace communication. Treat its advice as a planning aid, not a psychological assessment or a reliable basis for judging coworkers.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The localization self-check applies only before non-English output and supports the skill's disclosed language-matching behavior; it does not force unrelated language changes or expand authority.
[SQP-2] expected: The type-based portrait is part of the disclosed user-mirroring feature. It is somewhat flattering and should be treated as reflective shorthand, but the main skill repeatedly frames typing as a heuristic rather than a diagnosis, so this remains a guidance note rather than a Review concern.
